mostWorthwhile.text: Combining the fermenting contents with the body was most worthwhile because it brought the microbial products, mucus and water recovery into one picture.

leastWorthwhile.text: Adding mucus was clear but less informative on its own; its relationship to the microbes became clearer in the final construction.

surprise.text: I was interested that products of microbial fermentation can enter colon cells and, in some cases, the blood.

arbitrary.text: None of the combinations felt arbitrary: the item descriptions gave each a clear place or role in the colon.

continue.text: I would choose to continue. This chapter connected familiar digestion to a less obvious relationship between microbes and the body, although its three choices were fairly straightforward.
